hypothesis: An explicit sequential physical-evidence Bayes-factor tournament, coupled with prospective paid interventions chosen to distinguish old causal programs from the active program, can genuinely and repeatedly reactivate learned A and B context memory after returns, outperforming never-retrieve and Bayesian controls on identical paid physical action/state/consequence streams.
physics: Exactly frozen SL12 4-bit/4-action causal world, public complete Boolean program grammar, hidden A/B/C phases at paid indices [0,20,40,60], mandatory actual flips at [6,14,22,30,38,46,54,62,70,78]. SL13 world constructor accepts only the fresh registered seeds; no hidden labels or phase clocks passed to learners.
arms: archive_probe: new physical Bayes-factor archival learner with physically charged context diagnostic action choices for steps >=40
no_archive_on_probe: same learning algorithm, physical event stream, capacity and likelihood gate with archival retrieval prohibited
sl11_on_probe: fully unchanged SL11 witness context learner, independently paid identical candidate trajectory
noepisodic_on_probe: fully unchanged SL09 no-episodic program learner, independently paid identical trajectory
bayes_on_probe: independently implemented SL10 full public-grammar exact finite Bayesian learner, independently paid identical trajectory
archive_passive: same new archive learner but public fixed policy step%4 after 40; not matched information across policies
physical_inference: Each action's result is an actual charged physical state transition; a selector commits before seeing it. For a completed physical event, update a bounded window of last four real (prestate,action,changedbit) results. For each INACTIVE bank containing at least six real observations, compare its predictive hits on this SAME window with active-bank hits. Each extra archived-bank hit contributes log2 Bayes factor +4, with prior archive penalty 2 bits; accept archived reactivation ONLY when at least three distinct state/action witnesses, active makes >=2 errors, inactive makes >=3 of four correct, and log2 odds advantage >=6 (equivalent to >=2 more hits). Never use evaluator label, programmed phase, audit queries or learned hidden rule. No imagined evidence.
new_context_rule: When no previously populated archive clears the above physical-evidence gate and the active bank has >=6 genuine observations, two distinct (state,action) witnesses and >=2 misses among last 3 genuine physical events, create at most one NEW bank, bounded by three banks total. New bank is NOT counted as archive retrieval. Same criterion in no-archive arm. Clear physical witness window on retrieval or bank creation.
physical_probe_policy: After step40 at each causal (not flip) action, choose among the four public actions the one maximizing independent active-vs-archived predictive disagreement weighted by genuine archived sample count (saturates at 8), plus within-active top-six grammar program disagreement under its observed paid error counts, plus novelty for physically unseen state/action, deterministic rotation tie break. Without archived banks use grammar uncertainty. Every chosen probe is paid. Passive control keeps step%4. No free query, future outcome, or audit truth is read by the learner.
retrieval_proof: Archive retrieval requires a logged switch TO a previously active, already physically populated inactive bank with >=6 paid observations; document original physical birth step and read-only evaluator labels for phase of retrieval after execution. Count return-A and return-B events separately; creating a new bank or merely suppressing switches does not qualify.
audits: Uniform 16 public states ×4 actions, evaluator-only truth after paid steps 40,44,56,60,64,72,80; never train on audit truth; report all 512 final-pair cohort scores plus never-observed state/action metrics and early B2 step64.
cold_checkpoint: Full canonical <=8192-byte snapshots at paid steps 37,57,73 and end, restore into a separate instance and verify exact bytes and all 64 predictions; preserve witnessed history, real bank birth steps, accepted diagnostic reactivations, tamper detection. Checkpoint schedule not provided to learner.
comparators_and_cost: Five probe/replay arms independently pay for exact same before/action/after sequence per world; compare strictly on matched physical information and action identities. Passive uses matched step count but different information. Measure physical inference/selector CPU separately from world/evaluator and report per OS. Bayesian control is independent implementation over identical disclosed public grammar and charged observations; no claimed equal CPU.

frozen_primary.hard: All 32x6x80 real paid physical actions, 13,440 real causal observations, exact per-arm matched trace hashes, cold equality, within-8192 checkpoints, negative controls, cross-platform identical nontiming complete original raw results, mandatory full inherited regression on final exact SHA and G29 atlas check. Any hidden label leak, post-outcome threshold/seed retune or unqualified source makes INVALID.
frozen_primary.classification: Pass all frozen primary gates and integrity -> DEV_SIGNAL_NOT_SCIENCE, never direct SCIENTIFIC_PASS. Partial improvements with any failed gate -> MIXED_DEV. None -> NEGATIVE_DEV. Integrity/source defects -> INVALID. No unpreregistered promotion, AGI claim or production/native claims.

anti_leakage: Selector and agent access only public state, actual charged action, real observed next-state, and their own checkpoint bank. Physics program and schedule private. Access to static public grammar allowed equally for Bayesian control. Never infer hidden phase from clock; timestamps used only in offline evaluator to classify true retrieval.
limitations: Small toy Boolean world, 32 fixed synthetic seeds and short 20-step phases; false contextual coincidence and overfitting possible. A positive DEV result still needs independently implemented replicate, adversarial task and native substrate tests.
isolation: Separate draft PR stacked on #994; no main, accepted refs, native Yggdrasil model, owner/controller/loop, protected scientific first-use, Forge, Wingless, Hybrid, weight editing, workstation/WSL changes, scheduled tasks, live effects or paid APIs. All receipts GitHub repository/Actions only.
